item.title: John Arlott, Tim Key, & 9/11 – A new anthology of cricket poetry, TFW Book Club
item.description: Cricket attracts romantics. Whatever the form, so much of the game’s prose is dedicated to reflection and understanding. Whilst many fine writers have penned creative words, poetry isn’t as strongly associated. Catching The Light, compiled by authors Nick Hogg and Tim Beard, spans a wide range of contributors, from England’s John Arlott to Guyana’s John Agard, through to Tim Key and Zaffar Kunial of the modern day...
